localHeading: Matching repair work to the existing opening
localIntro: For a Hartville home, a replacement door should suit both the opening and the way the garage is used. We review measurements, headroom, panel construction, and lifting hardware alongside the style and finish you prefer.
localIssues: A new panel must match the existing system's dimensions and connection points. We review compatibility and the remaining door condition before presenting a section-repair option.
localAdvice: If appearance is part of the project, share whether you want to keep existing windows or hardware. We can compare those preferences with the available door designs after inspection.
localCommercialIntro: At a Hartville business, note whether the door serves customers, deliveries, or equipment storage. Include the responsible site contact and any restrictions on access while the opening is inspected.
